objective: Close the deterministic M08 freshness gate with at least 200 replay attempts against a stopped capture archive, proving that historical Vision analysis never becomes a current observation, fresh chat context or decision-support input.
non_goals: Do not run a real Vision model, Cloud request, desktop capture, GPU benchmark, repeated workflow or soak test.
Do not change the 15-second TTL, archive retention, owner consent, provider/model configuration, confidence threshold or VRAM budgets.
Do not persist replay output, screenshots, summaries, logs or verification artifacts.
Do not claim the owner scene-QA accuracy gate, diversity acceptance or Companion Gate B.
contracts: The test uses one temporary owner archive and one deterministic fake Vision analyzer; it never calls a real model, Cloud provider or desktop capture API.
The archive is explicitly stopped and the live freshness ledger is explicitly cleared before any historical replay begins.
Every one of at least 200 reanalysis results must remain historical=true, currentObservation=false and decisionSupportEligible=false.
After every replay batch, current observations and owner chat fresh context remain empty.
The existing exact TTL boundary test at T-epsilon, T and T+epsilon remains part of the same fast suite.
Temporary PNG data is contained by TemporaryDirectory and no raw replay artifact survives the test.
allowed_dependencies: Python standard library and existing repository test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic test executes at least 200 historical reanalyses after archive stop and live-ledger clear.
Zero replay result claims to be current or decision-support eligible.
Zero replay result appears in the fresh observation route or same-session owner chat context.
Perception tests and repository fast tests pass without materially increasing runtime.
Module-brief validation, GitNexus change scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M08-S27-stale-historical-replay-gate-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s workers/perception/tests -p "test_*.py"
